notes: Baseline (Opus 5.5, no plugin) is strong: 45/47. Most assertions are non-discriminating; the +4pp comes from 2 assertions (landed remote branch deleted; parser and README edits committed separately).
Cost: with-skill runs used ~35% more tokens and ~48% more time (they read skills, run hk plan/apply, and write structured reports with journals).

Qualitative gains not captured by assertions: every with-skill removal is journalled with undo; reports state the level and why; the close-task run filed a follow-up task carrying the unmet AC and recorded a deviation in the Story.

Engine defects found by these runs (fixed after iteration 1): hk wrote plans/journals into <repo>/.claude/housekeeping (untracked litter) -> moved to .git/housekeeping; a landed branch held by a clean worktree needed a second pass -> worktrees now apply first; claude project purge silently no-ops when the project dir name is not the path slug -> slug verified, fallback trash (S3).
Grader fixes during iteration 1: close-task accepts three legitimate outcomes; harness-audit ignores .claude.json/backups that any claude launch creates.
Next iteration should add discriminating cases: many squash-merged branches after dev moved on, a stale-looking-but-unlanded branch, a C5 clean room with rebuild proof, and a sandboxed runtime case.
